title: Cauliflower, Broccoli and Leek Quiche
subtitle: with a cheese streusel topping
description: A savoury shortcrust tart filled with lightly cooked cauliflower, broccoli and leek in a creamy egg custard, topped with a kashkaval streusel. The filling can also be baked on its own as a dairy pie.

steps.text: Make the pastry: mix 140 g butter, 240 g flour, the sugar and half a teaspoon of salt in a mixer until crumbly. Add 1 tablespoon of beaten egg, the water and the vinegar and mix just until combined, no more.
Continue working the mixture on the bench until a uniform dough forms. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for about 45 minutes until firm and easy to roll.
Partially cook the cauliflower and broccoli in boiling water for 15 minutes.
In a bowl combine the milk, creme fraiche, 3 eggs, 2 level tablespoons of flour, salt, white pepper and nutmeg to taste.
Fry the chopped leek in a pan with a little olive oil, add the partially cooked cauliflower and broccoli and toss together for about 2 minutes. Season lightly with salt and let cool.
Make the cheese streusel: put the grated kashkaval, 80 g flour, 80 g diced butter and half a teaspoon of salt in a bowl. Rub the butter into the flour and cheese until crumbs form.
Preheat the oven to 190°C. On a floured surface roll the pastry as thin as possible and line a 26 cm baking ring.
Arrange the vegetables on the pastry and pour over the creme fraiche mixture. Sprinkle the streusel on top and bake for 35 to 40 minutes.
